description: Fires when columns 0-1 are (nearly) empty and the left-centre shows an interlocked checkerboard: an opponent stone at row 1 of column 2 with my stone on top of it (row 2), and/or my stone at row 1 of column 4 with an opponent stone on top (row 2), often with opponent stones at the bottom of columns 4-5. Stones stacked in columns 0-1, or my stone in the bottom-left corner, switch it off; shifted copies do not fire.
effect: Weak: forcing it on/off moves the move distribution by at most about 0.15 (e.g. at its dev max, turning it off raises column 6 by 0.16; elsewhere forcing it high shifted 0.14 from column 4 to column 3). No consistent column effect.
notes: Hypotheses: (1) O at (1,2) + empty left cols: F1 0.30. (2) two vertical motifs A=(1,2)O/(2,2)X, B=(1,4)X/(2,4)O gated by empty cols 0-1: F1 0.38. (3) hand-weighted signature-cell count: F1 0.47 best (P 0.46, R 0.47, AUROC 0.73, sim share 0.34). Minimal pairs confirm A, B, left-emptiness and (0,0)X veto, but ~20% of strong firing lacks both motifs; looks like a distributed position-specific pattern, possibly a mixture.
